title: Benchmarking Obstacle-Conditioned Safety in Household Robot Navigation
abstract: arXiv:2610.34674v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Safe household navigation requires robots to regulate clearance and speed according to what an obstacle is and how close it is, without unnecessary conservatism. Yet existing evaluations do not test whether semantic safety distinctions are reflected in continuous motion. To that end, we introduce OSMA-Bench, an Obstacle-Conditioned Safe Motion Adaptation Benchmark built on spatially matched scenario sets that differ only in obstacle type. We also propose the \emph{Semantic Sensitivity Index} (SSI), which measures whether clearance and distance-dependent speed and smoothness follow the caution ordering of obstacles. Evaluating VLM-based and vision-language-action (VLA) policies on the benchmark, we find that neither consistently adapts its motion to obstacle safety, even with explicit safety prompts. translated_title: 基于障碍物条件的家庭机器人导航安全基准测试
translated_abstract: 安全的家庭导航要求机器人根据障碍物的类型及其距离远近调节安全间距和速度，同时避免不必要的保守行为。然而，现有的评估方法并未检验语义层面的安全差异是否体现在连续运动中。为此，我们提出了OSMA-Bench（障碍物条件安全运动适应基准），该基准构建于仅在障碍物类型上存在差异的空间匹配场景集之上。我们还提出了“语义敏感度指数”（SSI），用于衡量安全间距、随距离变化的速度和平滑度是否遵循障碍物的谨慎程度排序。在该基准上对基于视觉语言模型（VLM）和视觉-语言-动作（VLA）的策略进行评估后发现，即使给出明确的安全提示，这些策略也无法始终如一地根据障碍物安全性调整其运动。我们的分析表明，这些策略能够根据安全相关性正确区分障碍物，但未能将这种区分体现在其运动中。
tldr: 提出了OSMA-Bench基准和语义敏感度指数（SSI），用于评估家庭机器人导航策略能否根据障碍物类型调整运动安全性，发现现有VLM和VLA策略虽能识别障碍物的安全差异，却无法将其反映在连续运动行为中。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces OSMA-Bench and the Semantic Sensitivity Index (SSI) to benchmark whether robot navigation policies adapt motion to obstacle safety, revealing that existing VLM and VLA policies can correctly distinguish obstacles by safety relevance but fail to reflect this distinction in their continuous motion.
